scenarios.title: A｜正常取消
scenarios.setting: 在“取消预订 Cancelling a Reservation”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“正常取消”。

turns.text: Good afternoon, Grand Park Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想处理取消事宜，会怎样说明需求？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to cancel my reservation, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to cancel my reservation, please.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Hi, I’m calling to cancel a booking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m calling to cancel a booking.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: I’d like to cancel my room.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to cancel my reservation, please.
feedback.explanation: “cancel my room”能被理解，但真正取消的是预订；“cancel my reservation”更准确。

choices.text: I want cancel my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to cancel my reservation, please.
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

turns.text: Of course. May I have your name and reservation number?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. The reservation is under Alex Chen, and the number is 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. The reservation is under Alex Chen, and the number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: It’s under Alex Chen. My reservation number is 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s under Alex Chen. My reservation number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: My booking name is Alex Chen.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. The reservation is under Alex Chen, and the number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: “booking name”能理解；更常用“the booking is under + 姓名”说明预订登记在谁名下。

choices.text: My reservation number are 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. The reservation is under Alex Chen, and the number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: 一个预订编号用单数“reservation number”，因此搭配“is”；也可以直接报出编号。

turns.text: Thank you. I found your reservation for October 12th to the 14th. Would you like to cancel the entire reservation?

turns.prompt: 你想处理取消事宜，会怎样说明需求？

choices.text: Yes, I’d like to cancel the entire reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’d like to cancel the entire reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Yes, please cancel the whole booking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, please cancel the whole booking.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: Yes, that’s correct. Please cancel it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that’s correct. Please cancel it.
feedback.explanation: “that’s correct”确认对方复述的信息无误，让对方可以继续办理或安排。

choices.text: Yes, I want cancel all of it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’d like to cancel the entire reservation.
feedback.explanation: “want”后接动作时需要“to + 动词原形”；提出服务需求也可以用“I’d like to …”，既补全结构，也更委婉。

choices.text: No, I’d like to change the dates instead.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I’d like to change the dates instead.
feedback.explanation: “instead”说明改为修改日期；这与取消预订是两种不同的处理方式。

turns.text: Certainly. You’re still within the free cancellation period, so there won’t be any charge.

turns.prompt: 你想确认办理结果或确认信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will I receive a confirmation of the cancellation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I receive a confirmation of the cancellation?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Could you send me a cancellation confirmation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send me a cancellation confirmation?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Will you send me an email to confirm it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will you send me an email to confirm it?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Can you send me a cancel email?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Will I receive a confirmation of the cancellation?
feedback.explanation: 表示“取消”的相关规则、费用或确认时，用名词“cancellation”，如“cancellation policy / fee / confirmation”。

turns.text: Yes. We’ll send a confirmation email shortly.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Perfect. Thanks very much.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thanks very much.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Okay, I’ll check my email. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll check my email. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.text: You’re welcome. Your reservation has been cancelled. Have a nice day.

scenarios.title: B｜超过免费取消期限
scenarios.setting: 在“取消预订 Cancelling a Reservation”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“超过免费取消期限”。

turns.text: Good afternoon. How may I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想处理取消事宜，会怎样说明需求？

choices.text: Hi, I need to cancel my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I need to cancel my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to cancel a booking I made.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to cancel a booking I made.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: I’m calling about cancelling my reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m calling about cancelling my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: I need cancel my booking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I need to cancel my reservation.
feedback.explanation: “need”后接动作时通常用“need to + 动词原形”。补上“to”，才能把“需要”和具体动作连接起来。

turns.text: Certainly. Could I have your reservation number, please?

turns.prompt: 关于「取消预订」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes, it’s 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, it’s 58214.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Sure. My reservation number is 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. My reservation number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Yes, my number of reservation is 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, it’s 58214.
feedback.explanation: 一个预订编号用单数“reservation number”，因此搭配“is”；也可以直接报出编号。

turns.text: Thank you. I found your booking. Unfortunately, the free cancellation period ended yesterday.

turns.prompt: 你想了解超过免费期限后取消会有什么费用，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh, I see. What happens if I cancel now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, I see. What happens if I cancel now?
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Will I be charged if I cancel now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I be charged if I cancel now?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: Is there a cancellation fee?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a cancellation fee?
feedback.explanation: “cancellation fee”是取消费用；明确问这项费用，能与原订单价格区分开。

choices.text: So I can’t cancel anymore?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, I see. What happens if I cancel now?
feedback.explanation: 这句把超过免费期限理解成不能取消；对方可能只是在说取消会收费，应先问费用和条件。

choices.text: How much I need to pay if I cancel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, I see. What happens if I cancel now?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: You can still cancel, but there may be a cancellation charge.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: How much will I be charged?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much will I be charged?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: Could you tell me how much the cancellation fee is?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me how much the cancellation fee is?
feedback.explanation: “cancellation fee”是取消费用；明确问这项费用，能与原订单价格区分开。

choices.text: How much would it cost to cancel?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much would it cost to cancel?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: How much is the cancel fee?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: How much will I be charged?
feedback.explanation: 表示“取消”的相关规则、费用或确认时，用名词“cancellation”，如“cancellation policy / fee / confirmation”。

choices.text: How much will you charge me money?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much will I be charged?
feedback.explanation: “How much”已经指金额，句尾不再加“money”；说“How much will you charge me?”即可。

turns.text: According to your booking conditions, you’ll be charged for the first night.

turns.prompt: 你想询问取消费用是否有减免空间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is there any way to waive the fee?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any way to waive the fee?
feedback.explanation: “waive”表示免除原本应付的费用，适合向对方争取费用减免。

choices.text: Would it be possible to cancel without a fee?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to cancel without a fee?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: I understand. Is there anything you can do about the charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Is there anything you can do about the charge?
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Can you not charge me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any way to waive the fee?
feedback.explanation: 这句直接请求不收费，意思明确；用“Could the fee be waived?”更聚焦费用减免，也给对方核查规则的空间。

choices.text: Can you delete the money?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any way to waive the fee?
feedback.explanation: “delete”是删除记录等，不用于免除收费；请求免收费用可用“waive the fee”。

turns.text: I’m afraid the fee is part of the cancellation policy, so we’re unable to waive it.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand. Let me think about it before I cancel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Let me think about it before I cancel.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Okay. In that case, I’ll keep the reservation for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. In that case, I’ll keep the reservation for now.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: I see. I’d still like to cancel the reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. I’d still like to cancel the reservation.
feedback.explanation: 先表示理解费用规则，再用“still”明确继续取消，说明决定没有改变。

choices.text: Okay, don’t cancel it yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, don’t cancel it yet.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.text: Of course. Just let us know what you decide.

scenarios.title: C｜需要支付取消费用
scenarios.setting: 在“取消预订 Cancelling a Reservation”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“需要支付取消费用”。

turns.text: As your cancellation is past the free cancellation deadline, there will be a fee of $120, which is the cost of the first night.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: So I’ll be charged $120 if I cancel now?

feedback.naturalExpression: So I’ll be charged $120 if I cancel now?
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Just to confirm, the cancellation fee is $120?

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to confirm, the cancellation fee is $120?
feedback.explanation: “cancellation fee”是取消费用；明确问这项费用，能与原订单价格区分开。

choices.text: Does that mean I’ll lose the payment for the first night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does that mean I’ll lose the payment for the first night?
feedback.explanation: “does that mean”根据刚得到的信息核对含义，给对方纠正理解的机会。

choices.text: So you will charge me one night?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: So I’ll be charged $120 if I cancel now?
feedback.explanation: 能听懂要收一晚费用；更明确可说“charge me for one night”或直接核对金额。

choices.text: So I need pay $120 for cancel?

feedback.naturalExpression: So I’ll be charged $120 if I cancel now?
feedback.explanation: “need”后接动作时通常用“need to + 动词原形”。补上“to”，才能把“需要”和具体动作连接起来。

turns.text: That’s correct. The rest of your payment will be refunded.

turns.prompt: 你想确认款项何时退回或解除冻结，会怎么问？

choices.text: How long will the refund take?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long will the refund take?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: When should I receive the refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: When should I receive the refund?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: How many days does it usually take to get the refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: How many days does it usually take to get the refund?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: When can I get my money back?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: How long will the refund take?
feedback.explanation: 这句是自然口语；“How long will the refund take?”更侧重退款处理时长，表达重点略有不同。

choices.text: How long the refund will take?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long will the refund take?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: It usually takes five to seven business days.

turns.prompt: 你想处理取消事宜，会怎样说明需求？

choices.text: Okay. I’d still like to cancel the reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’d still like to cancel the reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: I understand. Please go ahead and cancel it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Please go ahead and cancel it.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: That’s fine. I’d like to proceed with the cancellation.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’d like to proceed with the cancellation.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Actually, I’ll keep the reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, I’ll keep the reservation.
feedback.explanation: “Actually”引出改变主意，“keep the reservation”明确保留现有预订。

choices.text: Okay, please continue cancel it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’d still like to cancel the reservation.
feedback.explanation: 这里要表达“仍决定取消”，重点是决定不变，可用“still want to cancel”；“continue”容易被理解为继续一个正在做的动作。

turns.text: Certainly. Just to confirm, you’d like to cancel the reservation and accept the $120 cancellation fee. Is that correct?

turns.prompt: 你想确认信息或告诉对方已经完成，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, that’s correct. Please cancel it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that’s correct. Please cancel it.
feedback.explanation: “that’s correct”确认对方复述的信息无误，让对方可以继续办理或安排。

choices.text: Yes. I understand the fee. Please go ahead.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I understand the fee. Please go ahead.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Yes, I confirm the cancellation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I confirm the cancellation.
feedback.explanation: “I confirm”明确表示确认这项操作，适合工作人员需要最终答复时使用。

choices.text: Yes, that’s okay for me.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that’s correct. Please cancel it.
feedback.explanation: 表达安排对自己可行，常说“okay with me / works for me”；若已决定取消，还应明确请对方办理。

choices.text: Yes, I am agree.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that’s correct. Please cancel it.
feedback.explanation: “agree”本身是动词，直接说“I agree”；前面不再加“am”。

turns.text: All right. Your reservation has been cancelled. You’ll receive a refund for the remaining balance within five to seven business days.

turns.prompt: 你想确认办理结果或确认信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will I receive a cancellation confirmation by email?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I receive a cancellation confirmation by email?
feedback.explanation: “by email”说明通过电子邮件发送，能明确接收信息的渠道。

choices.text: Could you send me a confirmation email?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send me a confirmation email?
feedback.explanation: “confirmation email”指确认邮件，用来核对办理结果。

choices.text: Okay. Could I get a confirmation of the cancellation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could I get a confirmation of the cancellation?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: You will send me an email, right?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Will I receive a cancellation confirmation by email?
feedback.explanation: 这句可以用于确认，但“email”没有说明内容；说“cancellation confirmation”能核实收到的是取消确认。

turns.text: Absolutely. You should receive it shortly.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Okay, thank you for explaining everything.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thank you for explaining everything.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll keep an eye out for the email.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll keep an eye out for the email.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
